gpu.name: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition

runtime.note: Benchmark jobs run sequentially with one worker after the 30-job science plan drained.

pre_benchmark_quiescence.evidence: Remote query after 30/30 statuses and all planned JSON/NPZ outputs verified; process list empty; nvidia-smi reported 0 MiB/0%.

scope: The same four physical paths per profile and common conditional noise draws are reused across backends, methods, C/N0 and controls. Conditional replica counts are arithmetic checks, not additional independent physical trials or tail qualification.

FP32-min covers complex64 FFT/GEMM; rank/UCB/physical simulation/static whitening/Gaussian covariance preparation remain CPU FP64. Gaussian/static score reductions use FP64 on the selected device. TF32 is disabled and highest matmul policy enforced; no lower/tensor arithmetic or native-instruction claim is made.
Only exported two-bit likelihood argmax is compared. Unexported per-frequency or internal covariance-mode rankings are not directly checked.

scorer wall begins after CUDA initialization; bounded child elapsed includes process startup. Conditional sampler+UCB includes simulation, not just reception. Method times include transfers, CPU work and finishing; Gaussian first-call covariance preparation is separately identified. No isolated GPU kernel or transfer-only timing is available.

Six jobs ran sequentially once in fixed order after a recorded idle precheck. Ratios are descriptive measurements for this shape, not randomized repeated benchmarks, universal acceleration, sensitivity qualification or an extrapolation to broad acquisition.

Runtime records one requested torch thread and OMP/BLAS environment1; threadpoolctl was unavailable, so independent BLAS thread-pool inventory is not recorded. Nominal32 vCPU differs from observed27.2 cgroup quota and256 visible logical CPUs.
Reported peak allocated/reserved CUDA bytes are framework counters, not total process RSS or whole-system peak memory.

The original remote temporary benchmark archive became0bytes for an unexplained reason. Scientific files were intact and repackaged under a new name; the verified local replacement archive is the one bound here. No benchmark jobs were rerun according to collection provenance.
